commentary.text: 90+10' The referee checks his watch and blows his whistle to signal the end of this match.
90+9' Amath Ndiaye (Valladolid) is given a fully deserved yellow card.
90+8' That will be a yellow card for one of the players. The one who gets booked is Marvin (Las Palmas).
90+8' Some great controlled play and passing in the middle of the pitch from Las Palmas.
90+4' Jose Campana (Las Palmas) swings in the corner kick, but one of the defenders leaps highest to head the ball away.

90+3' An accurate pass to the edge of the box is well taken by Enzo Loiodice (Las Palmas), whose instinctive shot towards goal flashes inches wide of the left post. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Valladolid.
90' We will have 8 min. of added time.
90' Las Palmas are bossing possession at the moment by exchanging some precise passes from player to player.
87' We are about to witness a subsitution. Enzo Loiodice (Las Palmas) for Javier Munoz.
87' Here is a change. Sandro Ramirez is going off and Diego Martinez gives the last tactical orders to Benito Ramirez (Las Palmas).
86' Here's the change. Ivan Sanchez leaves the pitch and Amath Ndiaye (Valladolid) comes on as a substitute.
86' Eray Comert comes off the pitch to be replaced by Abdulay Juma Bah (Valladolid).

85' Darwin Machis (Valladolid) collects a sweet pass on the edge of the box and in one movement smashes a shot in on goal, but it balloons high over the bar. The ball goes out of play and Las Palmas will have a goal kick.
82' Darwin Machis (Valladolid) takes the corner, but it's intercepted by the defender.
81' The corner from Darwin Machis (Valladolid) is intercepted by the defence. The ball goes out of play and Valladolid have been awarded a corner kick.
80' Scott McKenna (Las Palmas) is yellow-carded.
79' Las Palmas take the corner, but their hopes of scoring a goal end with a nice clearance by the defence.
79' Jose Campana (Las Palmas) decides to have a shot at goal from the free kick, but it hits the defensive wall. The referee signals a corner kick to Las Palmas.
79' Diego Martinez has decided to substitute Fabio Silva and he is replaced by Jaime Mata (Las Palmas).
78' Victor Andres Meseguer Cavas (Valladolid) sees a yellow card from Isidro Diaz de Mera after he sent one of the opposing players to the ground.
77' Luis Perez (Valladolid) crosses the ball into the box, but one of the defending players averts the threat.
77' Alex Suarez (Las Palmas) will miss the next game because of that yellow card.
76' The game is interrupted. Alex Suarez (Las Palmas) is given a yellow card. He has to be more careful now.
75' A substitution has been made. Kike Perez goes off and Darwin Machis (Valladolid) comes on.
75' The attendance is 21610.

74' The ball goes out of play and Valladolid will have a goal kick. Fabio Silva (Las Palmas) challenges for the lofted pass into the centre of the box, but has to stretch too much and sends his header narrowly wide of the left post.
72' Kike Perez (Valladolid) takes the ball and sets it for the free kick.
70' The foul by Alberto Moleiro (Las Palmas) was seen by Isidro Diaz de Mera who didn't hesitate to blow the whistle. That's a free kick to Valladolid.
68' Alvaro Rubio prepares a substitution. Mario Martin is replaced by Victor Andres Meseguer Cavas (Valladolid).
68' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Marcos Andre trots off the pitch and is replaced by Juanmi Latasa (Valladolid).

63' Alberto Moleiro (Las Palmas) is down injured and the referee stops play so that he can receive medical treatment.
58' Diego Martinez decides to make a substitution. Dario Essugo will be replaced by Jose Campana (Las Palmas).
58' Viti is not able to continue due to his injury and will be replaced by Marvin (Las Palmas).

54' Valladolid control the tempo of the game by exchanging some accurate short passes.
49' Eray Comert (Valladolid) will miss the next game.
49' Eray Comert (Valladolid) is awarded a yellow card for his tackle. He doesn't seem to agree with the decision, but Isidro Diaz de Mera ignores the protests.
46' Mamadou Sylla (Valladolid) gets on the end of a good pass and from mid-range he unleashes a decent strike, but the shot is blocked by the defender.
46' The referee blows his whistle to signal the start of the second half.
45+3' The match has reached half-time.
45+2' The resulting set piece from Las Palmas is comfortably intercepted by one of the defending players.
45+2' Isidro Diaz de Mera sticks with his original decision after the VAR review. No infringement and the goal stands!
45+1' The Valladolid players halt their celebrations as referee Isidro Diaz de Mera makes the VAR signal to review the goal, most likely to ascertain if there was an offside in the build-up play.
45' 1 - 1 Goal! Marcos Andre (Valladolid) finds himself some space inside the box to get on the end of a pass from Mamadou Sylla, then sends the ball into the bottom right corner. 1:1.

44' Mamadou Sylla (Valladolid) found some space to play in a lofted pass, but he looks disappointed as none of his teammates managed to connect with it. The ball goes out of play and Las Palmas will have a goal kick.

43' Marcos Andre (Valladolid) collects a great pass inside the box and misses a golden opportunity. His low shot was directed into the middle of the goal, but the goalkeeper does well to stop his effort.

41' Alberto Moleiro (Las Palmas) gets on the ball and beats an opponent, but his run is stopped by the referee Isidro Diaz de Mera who sees an offensive foul. A free kick has been awarded to Valladolid.
36' What a big chance! Kike Perez (Valladolid) picks up an inch-perfect pass inside the box and fires the ball just over the crossbar. The ball goes out of play and Las Palmas will have a goal kick.
35' Isidro Diaz de Mera blows for a foul after Lucas Rosa (Valladolid) was too aggressive in the battle for the ball.
33' The resulting corner, taken by Kike Perez (Valladolid), comes to nothing.
33' Lucas Rosa (Valladolid) sends a cross into the box, but the opposition's defence clears the ball to safety. Valladolid will take a corner kick.
32' Eray Comert (Valladolid) crosses the ball into the box from the free kick, but the defence clears the danger.
31' Dangerous play by Dario Essugo (Las Palmas). Isidro Diaz de Mera blows his whistle for a foul. Valladolid earn a free kick which could lead to a goal-scoring opportunity.
30' Alberto Moleiro (Las Palmas) was too fierce in his attempt to get the ball from his opponent and Isidro Diaz de Mera blows for a foul.
26' Fabio Silva (Las Palmas) will miss the next game because of that yellow card.
26' Isidro Diaz de Mera rightly pulls out a yellow card and shows it to Fabio Silva (Las Palmas).
25' Sandro Ramirez (Las Palmas) sends a teasing cross into the area, but Karl Hein intercepts the ball.
23' Luis Perez (Valladolid) tries to find the head of a teammate in the box but overhits the cross. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Las Palmas.
20' 1 - 0 Sandro Ramirez (Las Palmas) connects with a pass inside the box and slams home into the middle of the goal. The goalkeeper was helpless.

19' Fabio Silva (Las Palmas) meets a pass on the edge of the penalty area and shoots towards the middle of the goal. He didn't put enough power into the effort, though, and Karl Hein pulls off an easy save.
17' The ball possession is 75:25.
15' Sandro Ramirez (Las Palmas) delivers a fine lofted cross into the penalty area, but it's cleared by an opposing player.
12' Isidro Diaz de Mera blows his whistle for a foul after Mario Martin (Valladolid) hacks down one of his opponents. Las Palmas are awarded the free kick.
10' Ivan Sanchez (Valladolid) tries to create a chance, but puts too much weight on his pass. The ball goes out of play and Las Palmas will have a goal kick.
7' Las Palmas are showcasing great team work and neat passing moves.

3' The referee blows his whistle as Lucas Rosa (Valladolid) was too aggressive in his challenge. A free kick has been awarded to Las Palmas.
